setup: Run scorecard.py with --html tests/cricbay-pom-report/fixtures/no-report.html instead of a live id. Every team and player in the fixtures is invented.

evals.prompt: i umpired this game https://www.cricbay.com/scorecard/12345 , write the player of the match report
evals.expected_output: A draft of about 100 to 200 words in one code block for Asha Rao. It names Ben Cole's hat-trick as the rival case, cites the 2 wickets in the 9th over and the wicket maiden in the 17th, and adds no claim about the pitch or conditions. A check-list follows the block. Nothing is posted.

evals.prompt: can you do the PoM write-up for scorecard 12345
evals.expected_output: Notices that a report signed by Nora Wells already exists, shows it, and asks whether a new one is still wanted before drafting.

evals.prompt: write the pom report for cricbay game 12345
evals.expected_output: Reports that the game has no scorecard yet and stops, without inventing a report.
